outcome: Create or refine a Hookify rule that matches the intended event and fields, is stored at the correct path, and can be tested safely.
activation: User asks to create, write, configure, add, or refine a Hookify rule
User needs guidance on Hookify rule syntax or patterns
exclusions: Do not claim a rule is effective without a positive and negative pattern check
inputs_and_preconditions: Hookify event and rule file conventions are available

hard_invariants.description: Rule has required name, enabled, event, and pattern/conditions fields in valid markdown/YAML shape.
Selected event uses compatible fields and operators.
Pattern is checked against a matching and non-matching example.

decision_points: Select bash, file, stop, prompt, or all event
Choose simple pattern or multiple conditions
state: Rules are read dynamically on the next tool use
side_effects: Create or edit a local Hookify rule only when requested
Do not modify unrelated project files
